Website Sign In HomeDepartmentsRecreation & ParksEventsEgg Hunt Egg Hunt Annual Egg HuntThanks for joining us at our annual Egg Hunt in 2026! The next Egg hunt will take place Saturday, March 27, 2027. Plan to arrive early with a bag or basket to collect goodies. Egg hunters are separated by age: ages zero to three, four to six, and ages seven to eleven. All age groups go at the same time. Before and after the hunt, families can enjoy free arts & crafts, games, face painting, music, and bubbles. After the hunt, Mr. and Mrs. Bunny will be in attendance for pictures and a free magic show at the barn at 10:30 a.m. by Abracadbra Alex. Saturday, March 27, 2027Free and no registration requiredActivities begin at 9:15 a.m.Hunt begins promptly at 10 a.m.In the event that the Egg Hunt must be rescheduled due to inclement weather, the event will take place on Monday, March 29, 2027 at 4:30 p.m. Egg Hunt SponsorsEgg Hunt Sponsor opportunities are closed for the 2026 Egg Hunt. Explore upcoming sponsor opportunities at other City of Falls Church special events. Parking Lot Closure To improve safety for both the Falls Church Farmers Market and the Annual Egg Hunt, the City Hall and City of Falls Church Community Center parking lot will be closed on Saturday, April 4, from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. Egg Hunt attendees should arrive early and plan to walk or carpool.Where to Park:City of Falls Church Community Center Parking LotBoth the Kaiser Permanente Parking Garage and the lower level of the George Mason Square Garage accessed via South Maple will be open all day to the public and is your best bet for free public parking.Free parking is available on many side streets. Please check signs for time limits. Avoid parking in private parking lots. The private lots are for the customers of businesses only, watch for posted "No Parking – Towing Enforced" signs. Many businesses enforce parking restrictions on weekends and holidays and may tow without notice.
